name: Valdelagua del Cerro (Spain)
description: White field with a golden yellow cross offset towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with a blue compass rose and at the lower fly with the crowned arms of Valdelagua del Cerro.
history: Municipal flag of Valdelagua del Cerro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross with its vertical arm towards the hoist
Valdelagua del Cerro arms — towers on red above waves
